title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew made with lamb and a blend of spices, slow-cooked to perfection in a traditional clay pot.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.amount: 1 pound boneless shoulder, cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: Heat the buttery in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tunisian spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Fluff the fluffy couscous with a fork and serve alongside the tagine.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
